name: TabPanel

props.name: badgeIndicator
props.description: **Experimental**: Display an empty dot badge on the Tab.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Specify whether the tooltip for the icon should be open when it first renders

props.name: disabled
props.description: Specify whether your IconTab is disabled.

props.name: enterDelayMs
props.description: Specify the duration in milliseconds to delay before displaying the tooltip for the icon.

props.name: label
props.description: Provide the label to be rendered inside the Tooltip. The label will use `aria-labelledby` and will fully describe the child node that is provided. This means that if you have text in the child node it will not be announced to the screen reader. If using the badgeIndicator then provide a label with describing that there is a new notification.

props.name: leaveDelayMs
props.description: Specify the duration in milliseconds to delay before hiding the tooltip

a11y.note: Carbon ships a11y behaviour per component; verify per screen

when_to_use: Use Carbon TabPanel rather than building one.
when_not_to_use: Do not restyle off-token — propose a token instead.
